title: ParaView gallery: BraTS-2021 case 01017, 120-day MTD end-state
source: outputs_real/brats_case01017_mtd_day120.vti (committed artifact; produced by export_fields_vti after sim.run(..., keep_fields=True) on the cached BraTS-2021 case 01017 segmentation)
notes: simulation output on a real BraTS-2021 segmentation, not patient imaging of a treated tumour and not a clinical prediction
the diffusion field D(x) is derived from tissue classes the engine assigns geometrically; the per-voxel constants are declared assumptions
the paired steering arm on the same geometry and seed eradicates the tumour within the horizon, which is why there is no steering VTI: an empty volume renders as nothing (PARAVIEW.md)

headline.resistant_fraction_note: day-120 MTD end-state on this geometry is fully resistant (the sanctuary effect); PARAVIEW.md carries the derivation

captions.short: Spatial drug sanctuary under continuous maximum-tolerated dosing. Final state of a 120-day simulation on a BraTS-2021 segmentation (14×24×24 voxels at 1 mm). The engine integrated a heterogeneous diffusion field D(x): 0.01 mm²/day in necrotic core to 0.35 mm²/day in healthy tissue. The red isosurface encloses the residual tumour, which is 100% drug-resistant; drug concentration collapses inside the core that D(x) marks unreachable. Simulation, not patient data.

paraview_recipe: Open the .vti (Download button above) in ParaView, click Apply
Representation Volume, Color by drug_A, map Viridis, log-style opacity ramp
Filters > Contour by resistant at ~50% of max, color red
Filters > Clip, plane normal -X, to reveal the interior
Color the clipped surface by diffusion_mm2_per_day: D drops 35x across the tumour boundary
File > Save Screenshot at 3840x2160 with the color legend enabled
